from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path('D:/repos/wright')
local = root / '.local-run/process-interfaces-083'
label = sys.argv[1]
paths = [
    'apps/api/tests/test_process_ui_authoring_api.py',
    'packages/workspace_service/tests/test_process_ui_presentations.py',
    'packages/workspace_service/tests/test_process_ui_toolchain.py',
    'packages/workspace_service/tests/test_process_ui_authoring.py',
    'packages/workspace_service/tests/test_process_ui_build.py',
    'packages/data_vault/tests/test_process_interface_migrations.py',
    'apps/api/tests/test_process_ui_surface_authority.py',
    'apps/api/tests/test_process_interfaces_api.py',
    'packages/workspace_service/tests/test_process_interface_service_boundaries.py',
    'packages/workspace_service/tests/surfaces/test_process_ui_static.py',
    'packages/workspace_service/tests/surfaces/test_live_app_service.py',
]
assert all((root / path).is_file() for path in paths)
argv = [sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', *paths, '-q', '--tb=short', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider',
        '--basetemp', str(local / ('t038-' + label))]
with (local / ('t038-' + label + '.log')).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as log:
    log.write('argv=' + repr(argv) + '\n')
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                             text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
    for line in child.stdout:
        log.write(line)
        log.flush()
        print(line, end='', flush=True)
    code = child.wait()
    log.write(f'\nowned_exit_code={code}\n')
sys.exit(code)
